requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the caller-supplied reload value to IWDG_RLR.RL, which is within the 12-bit range.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the function writes the expected reload value to the IWDG_RLR register and the value is correctly represented in the ll_iwdg_regs array at index IWDG_RLR_OFFSET / 4U.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall ensure that the value written to IWDG_RLR.RL is not less than 2.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the API function fails or asserts an error if the caller supplies a reload value less than 2 during a write operation to IWDG_RLR.RL.
